blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A packing assistant sees a blue striped mug and an orange mug beside a box (Figure 1 a). A mug that disappears from view and reappears is still the same object: visibility changes while the number of distinct mugs stays fixed. The orange mug is then lowered into the box. The placement remains in progress while the hand holds it and completes after release. Observing the placed mug again preserves that completed-event count. These cases distinguish changes in visibility, identity, and completion ( Liu et al., 2026c ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Shangguan et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 一名包装助理看到一个蓝色条纹的杯子和一个橙色的杯子,旁边有一个盒子(图1a)。 一个从视图中消失和再现的杯子仍然是同一个对象:能见度改变,而不同的杯子数量则保持不变. 然后把橙色杯子放进盒子里 安置工作仍在进行中,而手拿着,在释放后完成。 再次观察被放置的杯子 保留了已完成的活动数。 这些案件区分了知名度、身份和完成率的变化(Liu等人,2026c;Yang等人,2025a;Shanguan等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Long-context and streaming vision-language models retain visual evidence through attention, recurrent summaries, or learned associative memory ( Bai et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025d ; Sun et al., 2025 ) . Hybrid local attention and online learners extend this context along a stream ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . The inventory clerk in Figure 1 b illustrates the additional role of a record: remembered appearance supports recognition, while the notebook indicates which placements have already been counted. Thus the same observation can warrant an update during an active event and a hold after completion (Figure 1 c). The key is to learn when current evidence changes previously recorded state.
blocks.zh: 长文和流畅的视觉语言模型通过注意、经常性摘要或学会的关联记忆保留视觉证据(Bai等人,2025a); 徐等,2026年;张等,2025年;杨等,2025年d;孙等,2025年. 当地注意力和在线学习者将这一背景延伸到溪流(Chen等人,2026年)。 图1b中的库存办事员说明了记录的额外作用:记起的外观支持识别,而笔记本则表明哪些位置已经计算。 因此,同样的意见可以在活动期间更新,并在完成后暂停(图1c)。 关键是当当前证据改变先前记录的状态时学习.

blocks.en: We introduce StaMina (State Maintenance), which learns to maintain the counting state through state-conditioned transitions. Gated delta memory carries causal appearance and motion context; typed state records current visible candidates, accepted identities, and completed events. An event head uses visual context and the current phase to score legal updates. Training sums the probabilities of paths consistent with supported count endpoints, allowing interval counts to supervise completion and persistence without assigning a boundary to every frame. The object branch separately learns visibility and association, so that an identity decision can be deferred while a visible mug remains countable.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Stamina(国家维护),通过有条件的过渡学习维持计数状态。 Gated delta内存带有因果外观和运动上下文;打入状态记录当前可见候选人,接受身份,以及完成的事件. 一个事件头使用视觉上下文和当前阶段来评分法律更新. 培训将路径的概率与所支持的计数终点相匹配,允许间隔计数监督完成和持久性,而不为每个框架划定界限。 对象分支分别学习能见度和关联性,这样在可见的杯子仍然可以计数时可以推迟身份决定.

blocks.en: This formulation connects data construction to the decisions being learned. The training resource must cover both identity-preserving reappearance and the transition from held to placed. We construct such supervision from visual tracking, independent prefix counting, and verified periodic transformations. The pool contains 39829 spatial queries and complementary event records. Count endpoints constrain the number of accepted updates; reliable identities and boundaries supervise their local meaning. Snapshot and interval queries share the underlying trajectory.
blocks.zh: 这种提法将数据构建与正在学习的决定联系起来。 培训资源必须既包括保留身份的重新出现,也包括从被扣留到安置的过渡。 我们从视觉跟踪、独立的前缀计数和经核实的定期转换中构建这种监督。 该集合包含39829个空间查询和补充事件记录. 计数端点会限制被接受的更新数量;可靠的身份和边界会监督其局部意义. 快照和间隔查询共享基本轨迹.

blocks.en: We instantiate StaMina-4B and StaMina-8B using the corresponding Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025a ) instruction models. Our contributions are: ∙ \bullet State-conditioned causal counting. A recurrent visual context and typed transition heads distinguish identity birth, visibility change, and event completion, with numerical answers read from the accepted state. ∙ \bullet Trajectory-constrained transition learning. A differentiable forward recurrence trains event transitions from supported count endpoints, while verified boundaries and identities supervise their respective operators. ∙ \bullet Trajectory data and evaluation. A multi-source pipeline supplies 39.8K spatial queries and complementary event trajectories. Evaluation at two model scales covers counting adaptation, online-video transfer on disjoint media, and count-conditioned action predicates.
blocks.zh: 我们使用相应的Qune3-VL(Bai等人,2025a)指令模型,即时使用Stamina-4B和Stamina-8B。 我们的缴款是:按国家条件计算。 反复出现的视觉上下文和打入的过渡头区分了身份出生,能见度变化,以及事件完成,数字答案从接受状态读取. * 弹射轨迹限制过渡学习。 一个不同的前向重现列车事件从所支持的计数端点过渡,同时经过验证的边界和身份监督各自的操作员. * 布尔轨道数据和评价。 多源管道提供39.8K空间查询和互补事件轨迹. 在两个模型尺度上的评价包括计算适应、在不连接媒体上进行在线视频传输和计数有条件的行动上游。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Long-video benchmarks test temporal evidence, retrieval, and spatial reasoning ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026c ; Niu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Kwan et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) . Online evaluation also ties answers to the observations available at a decision time ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Niu et al., 2025 ) . Streaming architectures maintain context through memory consolidation, decoupled perception, or selective retention ( Qian et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025d ; Zeng et al., 2025 ) . We study the subsequent decision that converts this context into a persistent count update.
blocks.zh: 长视频基准测试时间证据,检索和空间推理(Fu等人,2025年;Wu等人,2024年;Liu等人,2026年c;Niu等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年b;Liu等人,2026年b;Kwan等人,2026年;Fan等人,2026年). 在线评价还联系了对决策时提供的意见的答复(Lin等人,2024年;Niu等人,2025年)。 流体结构通过内存整合,脱钩感知,或选择性保留来维持上下文(Q等人,2024年;Q等人,2025年;徐等人,2026年;张等人,2025年;杨等人,2025年d; Zen等人,2025年). 我们研究了后来将这个背景转化为持续计数更新的决定.

blocks.en: Test-time training (TTT) adapts parameters online ( Sun et al., 2020 ; Gandelsman et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Nath et al., 2026 ) ; fast-weight layers use these parameters as recurrent state ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Tandon et al., 2025 ; Dalal et al., 2025 ) . StreamTTT uses nonlinear fast weights with short-window attention ( Chen et al., 2026 ) ; Spatial TTT adds geometry-aware prediction ( Liu et al., 2026a ) ; Cambrian-S studies persistent spatial recall and counting ( Yang et al., 2025b ) . Our continuous branch uses gated linear delta updates ( Yang et al., 2025c ; Kimi Team, 2025 ) . The counting mechanism resides in the state-conditioned transition model and its trajectory objective. ActionSwitch learns action-state changes with a conservative transition loss ( Kang et al., 2024 ) . Connectionist temporal classification (CTC) marginalizes compatible alignment paths ( Graves et al., 2006 ) , while neural video alignment learns from weak action annotations ( Richard et al., 2018 ) . We constrain operator-specific paths by multiple count endpoints, carry phase posteriors between them, and evaluate causal integer commitments.
blocks.zh: 测试时间培训(TTT)在线调整参数(Sun等人,2020年;Gandelsman等人,2022年;Wang等人,2025年a;Xie等人,2025年;Nath等人,2026年);快速重量层将这些参数作为经常状态使用(Sun等人,2025年;Tandon等人,2025年;Dalal等人,2025年)。 StreamTT使用非线性快重,短视(Chen等人,2026年);空间TT增加几何感知预测(Liu等人,2026a年);Cambrian-S研究持续空间召回和计数(Yang等人,2025b年). 我们的连续分支使用闸门线性三角洲更新(Yang等人,2025c;Kimi Team,2025). 计票机制存在于有条件的过渡模式及其轨迹目标中。 ActionSwitch以保守的过渡损失学习动作状态变化(Kang等人,2024年) . 连接时间分类(CTC)将兼容的对齐路径边缘化(Graves等人,2006年),而神经视频对齐则从弱动作说明(Richard等人,2018年)中吸取教训. 我们通过多个计数端点来限制操作者专用路径,在它们之间携带相后线,并评价因果整数承诺.

blocks.en: VSI-Bench, TOMATO, CountLLM, and AV-Reasoner study spatial reasoning, temporal reasoning, and repetitive or clue-grounded counting ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Shangguan et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . SVCBench distinguishes eight counting operators and their trajectories ( Liu et al., 2026c ) . We construct aligned supervision from ScanNet, ScanNet++, ARKitScenes, and Ego4D ( Dai et al., 2017 ; Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ; Baruch et al., 2021 ; Grauman et al., 2022 ) . Count-conditioned predicates connect the resulting state to action eligibility, complementing observation-to-control models ( Kim et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: VSI-Bench,TOMATO, CountLLM,和AV-Reasoner研究空间推理,时间推理,以及重复或基于线索的计数(Yang等人,2025a;Shangguan等人,2025;姚等人,2025;Lu等人,2026). SVCBench区分了八个计数操作员及其轨迹(Liu等人,2026c.). 我们从ScanNet、ScanNet++、ARKitScenes和Ego4D(Dai等人,2017年;Yeshwanth等人,2023年;Baruch等人,2021年;Grauman等人,2022年)构建对齐监督。 计算条件的上游将结果状态与行动资格联系起来,补充观察与控制模型(Kim等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: 4 Trajectory-Based Counting Data
blocks.zh: 4 轨迹计数数据

blocks.en: The data pipeline provides the update supervision required by Section 3.4 . Each trajectory fixes a source segment, target, operator, and count origin; its parent video determines the provenance and split membership. A supervision family links annotations within a parent through shared entities or events, temporal transformations, and count-derived answers. Segment-local counts reset at that segment’s origin, while queries within the segment share state.

blocks.en: 4.1 Video-to-trajectory construction
blocks.zh: 4.1 视频到传输构造

blocks.en: A proposal stage discovers countable objects and event descriptions from raw videos. For spatial targets, segmentation and tracking provide candidate visual evidence, while independent VLM prefix views estimate visible and cumulative counts. The acceptance stage checks agreement, supported changes, and conflicting re-identifications. Accepted records store N d ​ ( t ) N_{d}(t) or U d ​ ( t ) U_{d}(t) with their evidence references. These are quality-filtered automatic labels; stable instance IDs are retained where supported, and a fused count is not treated as an identity annotation.
blocks.zh: 一个提议阶段从原始视频中发现了可计数的对象和事件描述. 对于空间目标,分割和跟踪提供了候选的视觉证据,而独立的VLM前缀视图则估计可见和累积的计数. 接受阶段检查协议、支持修改和相互矛盾的重新确认。 接受记录N d (t) N_{d}(t) 或 U d (t) U_{d}(t) 及其证据参考。 这些是质量过滤的自动标签;在支持的地方保留稳定的实例ID,而未将引信计数视为身份说明。

blocks.en: Natural-event records use causal prefix counting and support checks for action, transition, and episode targets. Periodic records apply authorized temporal transformations to annotated source cycles, retaining the frame map and transformed completion boundaries. This gives count-trajectory supervision for all operators and boundary supervision for the subset with verified timing.
blocks.zh: 自然事件记录使用因果前缀计数和支持检查来进行动作,过渡,以及插曲目标. 定期记录将授权的时间转换应用于注释源周期,保留帧图和转换完成边界. 这使所有操作者的计数-导电监督以及对经核实的时间的子集的边界监督。

blocks.en: 4.2 Causal query compilation and auditing
blocks.zh: 4.2 原因查询汇编和审计

blocks.en: The query compiler samples supported endpoints and emits the target description, query time, causal media scope, and integer answer. O1-Delta is derived from two supported N d N_{d} endpoints; O2-Gain is derived from two supported U d U_{d} endpoints. Verified stable intervals are retained to supervise persistence; equal visible-count endpoints alone do not establish a stable interval. Rejected or unsupported observations are omitted rather than converted into zero counts.

blocks.en: An independent checker recomputes the differences, validates temporal order, checks duplicate IDs and media hashes, and verifies the parent key of every derived record. This establishes algebraic and provenance consistency. Perceptual label quality is assessed separately through held-out audits and the training ablations in Section 5.4 .

blocks.en: 4.3 Dataset composition and splits
blocks.zh: 4.3 数据集组成和分割

blocks.en: The multi-source counting pool combines indoor spatial videos, natural action videos, and transformed periodic sequences. The pool contains 15521 grouped records, 53592 query–answer pairs, 383 parent groups, and 1504 referenced media files. The spatial portion contains 39829 queries; natural events contribute 7109 and periodic transformations contribute 6654. The training and development splits of this pool contain 47882 and 5710 queries. Appendix B gives the per-operator inventory.

Both online-video evaluation sets and their derived media are jointly excluded from training and model selection. The inventory describes the source pool; Appendix G gives the selected training membership.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We train StaMina-4B and StaMina-8B from Qwen3-VL-4B/8B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025a ) . Counting-SFT denotes answer-token supervised fine-tuning on the same selected counting queries, without the added memory or state heads. Controls share visual-token and update budgets within each comparison. SVCBench covers 8 operators, 406 videos, 1000 questions, and 4576 timestamped queries ( Liu et al., 2026c ) , using the supervision-family split in Section 4 for counting adaptation. OVO-Bench and OVO-S-Bench evaluate online understanding and spatial reasoning through the language decoder ( Niu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . One checkpoint per model size and seed is used across all three benchmarks. Appendix A fixes the model and optimization settings; Appendix B specifies training membership and supervision-family exclusion.
blocks.zh: 我们从Qune3-VL-4B/8B-Instruct(Bai等人,2025a)出发,对Stamina-4B和Stamina-8B进行训练。 计数-SFT表示对相同的选定计数查询进行解答式监听微调,没有添加的内存或状态头. 控制在每次比较中共享可视化数据并更新预算. SVCBench涵盖8个运营商,406个视频,1000个问题,以及4576次加印的查询(Liu等人,2026c),使用第4节中的监管-家庭拆分来计算适应. OVO-Bench和OVO-S-Bench通过语言解码器评价在线理解和空间推理(Niu等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年). 所有三个基准都使用每个模型大小和种子的一个检查站。 附 录 A规定模式和优化设置;附录B规定培训成员和监督-家庭排斥。

blocks.en: For our models, Full resets the runtime per query and replays its causal prefix using unwindowed attention over at most 64 frames, or 128 on OVO-S. Stream processes new observations at 1 fps, retaining a 4096-token window, fast weights, and typed state. Both modes run the state interface. Counting targets are registered at the trajectory origin; matched controls receive them at the same time. General QA follows each benchmark’s question-reveal schedule. Gaussian Precision Accuracy (GPA) averages query scores within each question, then across questions. Monotonicity Consistency (MoC) and Update Detection Accuracy (UDA) evaluate cumulative trends and responses at true changes. Our benchmark scores average the unrounded scores of 3 training seeds. Every official query remains in the score, including graph-unreachable endpoints. Appendix C gives metric and reference-protocol details. Throughout, gray identifies the complete method; bold and underline mark the best and second-best values within the indicated comparison groups.

blocks.en: 5.3 Learning state transitions

blocks.en: The event-head comparison caches causal features, candidate associations, and lifecycle masks from a common training-only warmup snapshot. With these inputs frozen, it crosses phase input with expected-count or path-likelihood training and shares verified-boundary supervision. A separate annotated diagnostic set supports exact transition errors and paired comparisons; its construction is given in Appendix G . Table 2 shows that phase conditioning and the path objective both improve hard prefix counts. Their combination also reduces false updates on verified stable intervals. Hard exact match rises from 49.9 to 64.4 when phase conditioning is added to path training. The result concerns which legal transition is selected, since legal eligibility is unchanged across all rows.

blocks.en: Each control produces endpoint likelihood and hard prefix accuracy from the same checkpoint and causal rollout. The improvements persist on trajectories from endpoint-only sources, while verified boundaries provide a stronger timing signal. Phase conditioning can improve hard counts even when its mean-objective negative log-likelihood (NLL) changes little; endpoint fit and online accuracy therefore carry complementary information. Duplicate completions, missed increments, and acceptance delay jointly test whether fewer updates reflect more accurate decisions. blocks.en: The selected training set contains 41612 queries from 301 parents, including 11328 identity-supported and 4216 boundary-supported queries. Visual endpoint correctness ranges from 88.8% on natural events to 96.7% on periodic records. blocks.en: StaMina learns to maintain the counting state through state-conditioned transitions and trajectory supervision. blocks.en: E2-Periodic always uses a single global cycle stream. For the other event operators, the target schema fixes global or entity-associated counting before observations arrive: global actions use one stream and entity-associated actions use at most 4 slots. Learned target-conditioned pooling queries attend to current visual features. Candidates are ordered by visibility, with query index breaking ties; cosine duplicate suppression retains distinct feature vectors. Candidate–slot association maximizes summed cosine similarity subject to one-to-one matches above 0.5. Equal-score assignments use candidate order and then slot-creation order. An unmatched visible candidate takes the first unused slot; excess candidates are recorded as overflow. Slot prototypes are replaced by detached matched features. Slots retain their phase and prototype through absence and are not recycled within a segment. An absent slot has only hold enabled. Association and creation are causal, detached, and identical across mechanism controls.

blocks.en: The vision encoder stays frozen. During 256 warmup updates, only new memory branches and pooling/transition/association heads are trained with available answer, object, identity, and boundary terms. Joint training follows the Stream observation and KV schedule and updates those modules, the decoder, and visual projector for 3 epochs with the full objective, cosine learning-rate decay to zero, and the AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) settings in Table 4 . A batch contains 8 trajectories; token, object, identity, and boundary losses average over available sites within each trajectory, while the trajectory term retains its joint NLL. Each term is then averaged over contributing trajectories. Each complete-system final checkpoint is used across all benchmarks. Appendix E defines the separate frozen-input event-head controls.

The event forward graph and soft object accumulators remain connected to their supervised trajectory losses; optimizer updates follow the whole trajectory batch. At a visual step, context updates, scores are computed, and hard changes commit before query readout. Query forks are discarded. A new segment/count origin resets KV, slots, identities, logs, and matrices to their initial states; queries inside it do not reset state. Full reconstructs the prefix with unwindowed causal attention; Stream persists bounded context and typed state.

blocks.en: A grouped record contains a question and a sequence of supported query times and counts. Expanding it into SFT rows changes the physical row count but not the number of underlying trajectories. Delta and Gain reuse endpoints from their source trajectory. Multiple media files can be crops or temporal transformations of one parent. We therefore retain parent groups, grouped records, query points, and referenced media as separate inventory units.

blocks.en: Spatial and natural-event labels are automatically supported count trajectories. They provide supervision for count changes and persistence. Periodic transformations retain verified frame maps from annotated seeds and support temporal boundary training. Algebraic replay checks derived answers, while visual audits assess whether the source evidence supports the counts. Unsupported targets and failed generation attempts remain outside the accepted training pool.
blocks.zh: 空间和自然事件标签是自动支持的计数轨迹. 它们监督计数变化和持久性。 定期转换保留了附加说明的种子中经核实的帧图,并支持时间界限培训。 代数重播检查得出答案,而视觉审计则评估来源证据是否支持计数. 未获支持的目标以及失败的一代人尝试仍然在公认的培训人才库之外。

blocks.en: Every accepted endpoint links to its causal media scope and source evidence. Finite integer counts, ordered local timestamps, consistent endpoint differences, and operator-valid trends are required. Conflicting visual evidence disables the affected supervision mask; algebraic agreement alone does not create identity or boundary labels. Periodic boundaries additionally require the transformed frame map. Visual audits separately assess exact endpoint and interval-increment accuracy, stratified by source and operator.
blocks.zh: 每个公认的端点链接到它的因果媒体范围和源证据. 有限整数、订购本地时间戳、一致的终点差异以及操作员-验证趋势都是必要的。 相冲突视觉证据使受影响的监督罩失效;仅代数协议不能创建身份或边界标签. 周期边界还需要变换的帧图. 视像审计分别评估准确的终点和间隔递增的准确性,按来源和操作者进行分级.

blocks.en: A trajectory key contains parent, derived segment/frame map, canonical target, operator, and count origin. Exclusion operates on supervision families before SFT expansion. For one parent, aliases and overlapping entity/event scopes are linked across every timestamp, crop, speed change, and repeated-cycle derivative. The dependency graph links N N to Delta, U U to Gain, shared identity tracks to both object families, and event counts to their supporting phase/boundary annotations. Overlapping operator definitions and any QA answer derived from these nodes join the same connected component. If a component intersects a held-out benchmark target, all its count, interval, identity, boundary, and answer-token supervision is excluded from training and model selection. Consequently, hiding Gain alone cannot leave its two Unique endpoints available. Uncertain semantic matches are excluded rather than separated by wording.
blocks.zh: 轨迹密钥包含父,衍生的片段/帧映射,犬目目标,运算符和计数源. 在SFT扩展之前,对监督家庭实行排斥。 对于一个母体,异名和重叠的实体/活动范围在每一个时间戳、作物、速度变化和重复循环衍生物之间都联系在一起。 依赖图将 N N 连接到 Delta, U U 连接到 Gain, 共享身份轨迹连接到两个对象家族, 事件计数到支持的相/ 边界说明 。 重叠操作员定义和从这些节点中衍生出来的任何QA解答都加入同一个连接组件. 如果某个组件交叉了一个被搁置的基准目标,则其全部计数、间隔、身份、边界和答题监督被排除在培训和模型选择之外。 因此,仅靠Gain无法摆脱其两个独特的终点。 不确定的语义匹配被排除,而不是被措辞分隔.

blocks.en: SVCBench evaluates adaptation to held-out supervision families with partial source-video overlap. The family exclusions apply to all project-specific training stages and model selection, including warmup, answer fine-tuning, and transition training. Training and development records are grouped by source scene and video before these exclusions. For transfer, the union of OVO-Bench and OVO-S evaluation media, original source videos, and all derived media is removed from every training and development selection. One final checkpoint per scale and seed is then shared across all three benchmarks. Each run records family IDs, ancestry, exclusions, selected queries, and supervision-mask counts; the source-pool inventory is reported separately.

blocks.en: For counting, the target description and operator are registered at the trajectory origin; future answers and completion boundaries are not runtime inputs. Matched controls receive the same target information. Each target/operator trajectory is evaluated separately, so a resident-target timing measurement does not imply an unbounded number of concurrent targets. A late target replays the available prefix to construct its state, and that replay cost is included in its end-to-end latency. General QA follows each benchmark’s original question-reveal schedule.
blocks.zh: 在计算时,目标描述和运算符在轨迹源头注册;未来的答案和完成边界不是运行时间输入. 匹配的控件收到相同的目标信息. 每个目标/操作者轨迹分别评估,因此,驻地目标计时计量并不意味着并行目标的无限制数量。 晚期目标重放可用前缀来构建其状态,而重播成本则计入其端到端间歇. General QA遵循每个基准的最初问答时间表.

blocks.en: Diagnostic trajectories are independent of the training and model-selection parents. Endpoint-only and boundary-supervised strata describe the source’s available training annotations; all diagnostic endpoints are verified for scoring and are never optimization inputs. Within each event-head condition, the same control checkpoint and cached causal inputs produce endpoint NLL and greedy hard-prefix predictions. Reported NLL divides the joint conditional negative log-likelihood by the number of verified endpoints. Predictions are matched chronologically within a slot to the nearest unmatched true completion in the preceding 3 seconds. Additional predictions within a true-completion window are duplicates; unmatched true completions are misses and predictions outside all windows are false updates. Stable false-update rate counts verified sampling intervals containing any commit, excluding intervals within 3 seconds on either side of a true completion. False-update rate divides marked stable intervals by all eligible stable intervals; duplicate and miss rates divide their counts by ground-truth events. These ratios pool counts across trajectories and seeds. Delay averages prediction time minus matched completion time over all matched events; unmatched events remain misses. Parent-level paired intervals quantify the factorial contrasts. Low NLL and poor hard counts identify a remaining surrogate/decoder gap; delay is reported alongside accuracy so conservative holds cannot appear successful merely by suppressing updates.
blocks.zh: 诊断轨迹独立于培训和模式选择父母。 仅端点和边界监督层描述源的可用训练说明;所有诊断端点都经过校验得分,从不优化输入. 在每一个事件头条件中,相同的控制检查点和缓存的因果输入都会产生端点NLL和贪婪的硬前缀预测. 被报道的NLL将联合有条件负对数的对数除以已核实的终点数. 预测在时间顺序上与前3秒内最接近的未匹配的真实完成相匹配。 真补全窗口内的其他预测是重复的;没有匹配的真补全缺失,所有窗口外的预测都是虚假更新. 稳定的假更新率计算了经核实的包含任何承诺的采样间隔,不包括在真正完成的两侧3秒之内的间隔。 假更新率将所有符合条件的稳定间隔间划为稳定间隔;重复和错漏率将其计数除以地面真实事件。 这些比率包括各种轨迹和种子。 在所有匹配事件中,平均延迟预测时间减去相应的完成时间;未匹配的事件仍然缺失。 父母级对偶间隔量化因子对比. 低NLL和差的硬数确定一个剩余的代用/解码漏洞;延迟报告与准确性并列,因此保守的搁置不能仅仅通过压制更新而显得成功。

blocks.en: Object controls follow complete-system joint training, setting λ i \lambda_{i} to zero or retaining the complete objective. Registry-update rules are shared, and each condition rolls its own predicted identity history. Both count-only-source and identity-verified-source records contribute soft/hard Unique error and supported Gain error. NEW precision/recall, re-entry duplication, unresolved identities, and acceptance delay use the verified subset, and retrieval misses are identified in the error log. Soft/hard Unique MAE uses supported endpoints; Gain MAE uses consecutive endpoint differences, including the empty pre-observation origin before the first query. NEW precision counts the first accepted birth of a true identity as a true positive and repeated or unmatched births as false positives; recall divides true positives by the number of true identities. Re-entry duplication is measured per re-entry encounter. Unresolved rate sums seen-but-unaccepted identities over queries and divides by all seen-identity exposures at those queries. Identity ratios pool their numerators and denominators across trajectories and seeds. Delay averages acceptance minus first-seen time over all resolved identities, with unresolved cases retained in the unresolved rate. Cross-query errors retain the original first-seen target time even when identity is accepted later. Soft birth fitting and hard identity acceptance are compared empirically rather than equated.

blocks.en: Candidate overflow, missed observations, and identity association errors can precede transition scoring. Fixed event slots preserve phase through absence but bound the represented entity streams. The accepted-identity index and event log grow with distinct objects and accepted events, even while neural context stays bounded. Endpoint likelihood and soft births are training objectives; online integer correctness and acceptance timing are measured on hard rollouts. The transfer benchmarks test the shared checkpoint on excluded media, while SVCBench measures the declared same-video new-question adaptation.

blocks.en: The event collection contains 160 trajectories from 40 parent videos, balanced across the four event operators. The object collection contains 160 trajectories from 40 parents. Each trajectory has 5 endpoint queries. These additional videos come from the source collections used by the pipeline and are excluded from training and development before model fitting; they are not counted in the source-pool inventory. blocks.en: Event strata identify whether the source pipeline supplies count endpoints alone or also verified boundaries. Dense temporal annotations are added to both diagnostic strata for evaluation and are never used to fit their models. Object count-only sources have verified visible and cumulative endpoints; identity-supported sources additionally have verified physical tracks. Identity metrics use the latter group, while both groups contribute count errors. Each collection is balanced between its two source strata. This grouping distinguishes available training supervision from evaluation annotations.

blocks.en: GPA, hard exact match, endpoint-normalized NLL, and mean absolute error (MAE) average within trajectories and then across trajectories and seeds. Ratio metrics instead pool numerator and denominator across trajectory–seed records: false updates use eligible stable intervals; duplicates and misses use ground-truth events; identity ratios use their specified eligible identity units. Delay pools all matched completions or resolved identities. Parent-level resampling retains all trajectories and all seed predictions belonging to a selected parent. The two event-head contrasts use the same resampled parent indices for both conditions and 10000 replicates. Their intervals describe variation across parents conditional on the evaluated seed set. The factorial event study trains separate head-only control checkpoints on common frozen inputs. The complete object and matched-access evaluations use the end-to-end benchmark checkpoint; the identity-loss ablation is trained separately. With path likelihood fixed, phase conditioning adds 14.4 GPA points (95% interval: 11.4–17.3); with phase conditioning fixed, path likelihood adds 18.8 points over expected-count training (15.9–21.7). These are conditional contrasts on the common frozen inputs.

blocks.en: The runtime evaluation uses the complete 8B model on the same NVIDIA H200 host, BF16 arithmetic, and batch size 1. General-QA latency averages requests generating 32 output tokens. Stream begins with the visual prefix already processed and takes 0.48 seconds per request; Full includes its 64-frame causal prefix replay and takes 1.72 seconds. These are mean request latencies, with no seed-level confidence interval attached.

blocks.en: Chronological visual ingestion runs at 9.6 frames per second, including the vision encoder, causal memory, and typed-state update for a registered counting target. A typed-count read takes 1.8 milliseconds on average, including CPU as-of lookup and answer assembly; it performs neither neural decoding nor visual replay. This read uses the already maintained target state.
blocks.zh: 编年史视觉摄入量为每秒9.6帧,包括视觉编码器,因果记忆,以及注册计数目标的输入状态更新. 键入计数读取平均需要1.8毫秒,包括CPU作为查看和答题组装;它既不进行神经解码,也不进行视觉重播. 此读取使用已经保持的目标状态 。

blocks.en: A late-target diagnostic retains exactly 1800 observations from a 30-minute history. Replay uses these retained frames without adding an observation at the zero-time boundary. On target revelation, those cached frames are processed chronologically through the counting stream, using observations no later than the query cutoff. Replay processing time is the retained-frame count divided by 9.6 frames per second; adding the typed-read cost gives 187.50 seconds after rounding. This cost calculation uses the explicit retained trace and differs from the Full general-QA request above. The host ledger occupies 84 and 1240 kilobytes after 1 and 30 minutes, respectively, using decimal kilobytes.
blocks.zh: 晚期目标诊断从30分钟的历史中保留了1800个精确的观察. 重放使用这些保留的帧,而不在零时边界上添加观测值. 在目标启示时,这些缓存框架通过计数流按时间顺序处理,使用观察不晚于查询截断. 重播处理时间是保留帧数除以每秒9.6帧;加上打字费用后四舍五入给出187.50秒. 这种成本计算使用明确的保留跟踪,与上述全面一般质量评估要求不同。 主机分类账在1分钟和30分钟后分别占用84和1240千字节,使用小数千字节.

blocks.en: Appendix I Precursor Component Evaluation

blocks.en: The precursor continuous-memory experiments use Qwen3-VL-8B with parallel MLP-TTT branches and the language-model answer decoder. Full replays each causal prefix independently. Persistent Stream uses a local KV window, carries visual state between questions, and discards each QA fork after decoding. These experiments use nonlinear MLP fast weights and precede the delta-memory transition model. They identify effects of that continuous component.
blocks.zh: 前体连续模态实验使用Qune3-VL-8B与平行的MLP-TTT分支和语言模型解码器. 完全重放每个因果前缀独立. 持久流使用本地的KV窗口,在问题之间携带视觉状态,解码后丢弃每个QA叉. 这些实验使用非线性MLP快速重量,并先于三角模态过渡模型. 它们确定了这一持续组成部分的影响。

blocks.en: The continuous branch admits a separate intervention before an event reader is attached. On the adaptation split, two-stage training increases Full GPA from 42.01 to 55.61. Setting the learned branch gates to zero reduces it to 30.65; the paired difference is 24.96 points, with a 95% interval of [22.45, 27.38]. This establishes that the adapted model uses the branch, including its interaction with the jointly adapted language model.
blocks.zh: 连续分支在事件阅读器附后前接受单独发言. 在适应拆分方面,两阶段培训将GPA全文从42.01增加到55.61. 将学习的分支门设置为零将其降低到30.65;对位差为24.96分,间隔为95%[22.45,27.38]. 这确立了经调整的模型使用分支,包括它与联合调整的语言模型的互动.

blocks.en: On the development split, the dynamically updated streaming model scores 31.91 GPA, compared with 26.12 for a fixed fast-weight state. Initializing from the Full-adapted checkpoint raises the score to 36.80, a paired gain of 4.89 points [1.77, 7.96]. Further streaming training reaches 39.05; its additional GPA interval [-1.65, 6.35] crosses zero. These results motivate supervising state transitions directly rather than relying on additional recurrent training alone. The component settings and reader control are given below.
blocks.zh: 在开发拆分上,动态更新的流线模型得分31.91 GPA,而固定快速重量状态则为26.12. 从完全适应检查站开始初始化,将得分提高到36.80分,成对得分4.89分[1.77,7.96]. 进一步的溪流训练达到39.05;其额外的GPA间隔[1.65,6.35]为零. 这些成果促使直接监督国家过渡,而不是仅仅依靠额外的经常性培训。 组件设置和阅读器控制如下。

blocks.en: Table 15: Continuous-component diagnostics. Full rows evaluate the adaptation split; Stream rows evaluate the development split. Each block retains its precision and training setup and is ranked separately.
blocks.zh: 表15:连续组成部分诊断。 全行评价适应拆分;流行评价开发拆分. 每个区块保留其精度和培训设置,并分别排名.

blocks.en: Zeroing the trained branch gates measures dependence on the branch in the jointly adapted network. Freezing fast weights stops the update, momentum, and decay together. These interventions characterize branch use and recurrent dynamics; the discrete-state interface is evaluated separately.
blocks.zh: 将训练有素的分支闸门零度测量对联合改造网络中的分支的依赖性. 冰冻的快速重量 阻止了更新、动力和衰变 这些干预措施是分支使用和经常动态的特点;离散状态接口另行评估。

blocks.en: The reader experiment freezes the continuous-memory parameters and fits a last-layer MLP adapter. Exact answers increase from 231 to 244 out of 866, an EM gain of 1.50 points [0.13, 2.77]. The GPA interval crosses zero. This distinction is expected because query-point EM and question-averaged GPA assign different weights to trajectories.
blocks.zh: 阅读器实验将连续模参数冻结,并适合最后一个层的MLP适配器. 准确的答案从866分中的231分增加到244分,EM增益1.50分[0.13,2.77]. GPA间隔跨0. 这种区分是预期的,因为查询点EM和问题平均GPA给轨迹分配了不同的权重.

blocks.en: General video understanding is checked on 2700 Video-MME questions without subtitles. Full-adapted initialization scores 55.70%, while further streaming count adaptation scores 54.30%. The task-specific adaptation therefore changes the accuracy tradeoff beyond counting.
blocks.zh: 在2700个视频-MME问题上检查一般视频理解,没有字幕。 完全适应的初始化分数为55.70%,而进一步的流线计数适应分数为54.30%. 因此,针对具体任务的调整改变了准确性的权衡,超出了计算的范围。

blocks.en: A later paired control evaluates an external state-summary reader on the same 866 queries. The memory condition answers 241 correctly (27.83%), while zeroing its memory input yields 244 (28.18%): a difference of -0.35 points. Across 26 training-cache records, 100% of the inspected write activations are saturated and the minimum cosine similarity between read directions is 0.99999988. This adapter behaves almost like a fixed readout direction; its result does not establish content-specific long-term retrieval. It is distinct from the fast-weight gate test and the typed event-state interface.
blocks.zh: 后配对控件在相同的866个查询上评价一个外部的状态摘要阅读器. 内存条件正确回答241(27.83%),而零化其内存输入值为244(28.18%):差值为-0.35分. 在26项训练-缓存记录中,被检查的书写激活100%是饱和的,读取方向之间的最小余弦相似度为0.99999988。 这个适配器的行为几乎像一个固定的读出方向;它的结果并没有建立针对内容的长期检索. 它区别于快重门测试和打出的事件状态界面.

blocks.en: In a precursor MLP-memory execution test, the 8B engine processes 8899 frames and 581709 video tokens across 15 queries. It sustains 21.99 fps with 36.40 GiB GPU allocation, 2.73–2.78 GiB host RSS, and 0.300 seconds p95 ready-prefix first-token latency.
blocks.zh: 在一次前体的MLP-memory执行测试中,8B引擎处理8899帧和581709视频令牌,跨越15个查询. 它维持21.99 fps,配有36.40 GiB GPU分配,2.73–2.78 GiB主机RSS,0.300秒p95 即时前缀第一键空位.

blocks.en: The fixed-sensor assay uses a causal pixel recurrence estimator on 25 periodic videos. Prefix estimates are computed at each query time, and the append-only ledger commits supported nonnegative increments. The direct estimates and the ledger both achieve 80.0% exactness; the ledger prevents downward revisions and changes MAE from 3.256 to 3.248. Clearing and delaying the ledger each yield 0.0% exactness; cross-video swapping yields 31.2%. This assay holds perception fixed and measures the dependence of the readout on correctly indexed state.
blocks.zh: 固定传感器测定在25个定期视频中使用了因果像素重现估计器. 在每个查询时间计算前缀估计数,仅附加分类账承付支持的非负递增。 直接估计数和分类账均精确度达到80.0%;分类账防止向下修改,并将MAE从3.256改为3.248。 清理和推迟分类账,每个分类账的精确度为0.0%;交叉视频交换的精确度为31.2%。 这个例子使感知得到固定,并衡量读出对正确的索引状态的依赖。

blocks.en: Appendix K Online and Spatial Transfer Protocols
blocks.zh: 附录K 在线和空间转让议定书

blocks.en: The transfer tests use the same counting-trained 4B and 8B checkpoints as SVCBench. No OVO-Bench or OVO-S questions, answers, or evaluation videos are used for task adaptation or checkpoint selection. A single training selection jointly excludes both benchmarks’ matching source videos and transformed descendants. Full samples at most 64 prefix frames on OVO-Bench and 128 on OVO-S. Stream ingests at 1 fps with a 4096-token window. The pretrained Stream controls retain the same observation rate and KV budget without the learned fast-weight or counting-state modules. Runtime state resets by video, while question decoding uses disposable forks. Benchmark prompts determine the original answer format; these general questions do not supply the typed counting interface.
blocks.zh: 转移测试使用与SVCBench相同的计票训练4B和8B检查站. 没有OVO-Bench或OVO-S问题,答案或评价视频用于任务调整或检查点选择. 一个单一的培训选择共同排除了两个基准的匹配源视频和改造后的后代。 在OVO-Bench上的最多64个前缀框和OVO-S上的128个前缀框的完整样本. Stream egests at 1 fps,带有4096-token窗口. 预训流控制保留了相同的观测率和KV预算,没有学习到的快速重量或计数状态模块. 运行时状态通过视频重播,而问题解码则使用一次性叉. 基准提示决定了原始的答案格式;这些一般问题不提供输入的计数界面.

blocks.en: The fixed released annotation set contains 1640 records from 644 videos, yielding 3035 scored decisions. We retain real-time visual perception (RT), backward tracing (BT), and forward active responding (FA) ( Niu et al., 2025 ) . Accuracy is computed over queries within each task, then averaged over tasks within a group and over the three groups. FA retains every scheduled trigger in the accuracy track, including repeated timestamps belonging to separate entries. A Full decision replays its available prefix; a Stream decision advances through newly arrived frames. Trigger schedules and answer extraction are shared across models; invalid responses count as incorrect.
blocks.zh: 固定发布的注释集包含644个视频的1640个记录,产生了3035个得分的决定. 我们保留实时视觉感知(RT)、后向追踪(BT)和前向主动反应(FA)(Niu等人,2025年)。 准确性是在每项任务中的查询中计算出来的,然后在一组内和三个组内平均计算。 FA保留了准确轨迹中每个预定触发器,包括属于单独条目的重复时间戳. 一个完整的决定重现其可用的前缀;一个流决定通过新到达的框架推进. 触发调度和解答提取在模型中共享;无效响应计为不正确.

blocks.en: The released OVO-S snapshot contains 1695 items from 334 videos; expanding multi-time questions gives 1722 scored queries. Its four levels cover instantaneous egocentric perception, spatiotemporal context tracking, generative spatial reasoning, and allocentric mapping ( Li et al., 2026 ) . We retain the multiple-choice prompts, greedy decoding, and 1024-token output cap. Answer extraction accepts the labels in each question’s option set; invalid or failed responses remain in the denominator. We compute query accuracy within each task family, average the three families in each level, and give the four levels equal weight in L-Avg. Query-pooled accuracy is retained separately. The same frozen query list and aggregation apply to every initial-model and adapted-model comparison.
blocks.zh: 发行的OVO-S快照包含334个视频的1,695个项目;扩展的多时问题给出了1722个评分查询. 它的四个层次包括瞬间自我中心感知,spatiental上下文跟踪,基因空间推理,以及异心制图(Li等人,2026年). 我们保留了多选择的提示, 贪婪的解码, 和1024 -token输出盖。 解答提取接受每个问题选项集中的标签;无效或失败的回复留在分母中. 我们计算每个任务家庭的查询准确度, 平均每个级别三个家庭, 并给予四个级别在L-Avg的同等权重。 查询集合精度另行保留. 相同的冻结查询列表和汇总适用于每一个初始模型和适应模型的比较.

blocks.en: Scores for StreamForest-7B and the memory-based Flash-VStream-7B ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) on OVO-Bench follow the three-group results in Zeng et al. (2025) , with native sequential ingestion. Their spatial scores follow Li et al. (2026) . Both are grouped under Stream, with their original evaluation releases and input rates: StreamForest uses one frame per second on both benchmarks; Flash-VStream uses one frame per second on OVO-Bench and two on OVO-S. The matched Qwen controls and StaMina share the frozen evaluation releases, observation budgets, and answer extraction described above.
blocks.zh: StreamForest-7B的得分和OVO-Bench上的基于记忆的Flash-VStream-7B(Zhang等人,2024年)跟随Zeng等人(2025年)的三组结果,原生顺序摄入. 它们的空间分数跟随李等人(2026年). 两者按原有的评价发布率和投入率归为Stream: StreamForest在两个基准上每秒使用一个帧;Flash-VStream在OVO-Bench上每秒使用一个帧,在OVO-S上使用两个帧. 匹配的Quen控件和Stamina共享上面描述的冻结评价发布,观察预算和解答提取.

blocks.en: On the original 1680-item OVO-S evaluation set, Qwen3-VL-4B uses the same prefix-frame cap as Full and scores 43.25/48.18/54.54/41.35 on L1–L4, with L-Avg. 46.83 ( Li et al., 2026 ) . The Qwen3-VL-4B comparison in Table 17 instead uses the frozen evaluation release specified above.
blocks.zh: 在原1680年项目OVO-S评价集上,Quen3-VL-4B使用与Full和分数相同的前缀框盖. 关于L1-L4的43.25/48.18/54.54/41.35,与L-Avg.46.83(Li等人,2026年)。 表17中的Qwen3-VL-4B比较则采用了上述冻结的评价释放。

blocks.en: The two transfer benchmarks probe different question families and are not combined into a single score. Their source domains can overlap. The breakdown distinguishes improvements in historical and spatial context from changes in immediate perception and general reasoning; it does not assume uniform transfer across tasks. The Video-MME control in Appendix I additionally records the behavior of an earlier component-only adaptation recipe.
blocks.zh: 两项转移基准探索了不同的问题家族,没有合并成一个分数. 它们的源域可以重叠. 分解将历史和空间背景的改善与即时感知和一般推理的变化区分开来;它不承担不同任务的统一转移. 附录中的视频- MME 控制 另外我还记录了 早期只包含组件的适应食谱的行为

blocks.en: The data controls use the same 8B checkpoint family, training updates, and visual-token budget. The visual-alignment control keeps each trajectory’s timestamp slots, legal count endpoints, and supervision masks fixed while permuting its visual observations. The candidate association graph is held fixed in this control, so count reachability and the number of supervised endpoints are unchanged. Observations are processed causally in the resulting perturbed sequence; this is a training corruption, not an alternative evaluation input. Filtering changes label selection. Figure 6 summarizes the access gap at both model scales, and Table 20 gives the exact predicate accuracies underlying Figure 7 .
